decisions.reason: Although no longer visible on the website, this illuminated candle-arch line remains close to the firm's traditional handcrafted competence base, so we would keep it for now while accepting some risk that the sound variant proves too peripheral.
This one-tier Christmas pyramid sits squarely within the firm's established product architecture and workshop know-how, making it a natural product to retain even without recent website prominence.

Because this motif platform depends on the electronic music-box system that lost its flagship product and lies outside the firm's strongest knowledge base, we would discontinue it and redirect resources to core craft products.
This seasonal platform is even harder to justify after the withdrawal of the electronic music-box line, since it combines a distant technology base with a narrow niche and weak visible traction.

The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's core seasonal wooden craft capabilities, so we would keep it, though its specific regional motif makes it somewhat more expendable than a standard pyramid.
